1_the_delivery.why_a_third_namespace: an attempt already has a RESULT surface (/output, validated and frozen) and a PROTOCOL surface (/run/baton/exchange, read as receipts/states/terminals). A log under either would be read as the wrong kind of thing by whatever owns that surface.
1_the_delivery.restart: adopt() re-enters without destroying anything, so partial evidence survives error, abnormal termination and restart
1_the_delivery.missing_is_not_empty: absent | empty | captured | truncated | partial | failed. The writer's own word is trusted over the file for partial/truncated/failed, because a file cannot tell you it is a prefix.
1_the_delivery.mode_has_one_owner: LOG_DIR is workspaces.WORKSPACE_DIR, the constant the establishing function chmods to, so adopt cannot start refusing rooms this module made
